title: Conformal boundary rigidity from null geodesic travel times
summary: The gravitational field of a distant, isolated system is manifested by the conformally invariant Weyl tensor. Thus the conformal structure far from the system encodes the system's gravitational mass. It also encodes the causal structure, thereby linking it to the mass. For asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes, this link led to a novel positive mass theorem of Page, Surya, and the second author \cite{PSW} which did not rely on any traditional energy condition.
